fullTextAndSupplement: Original publisher CDN full article and linked supplementary_data ZIP containing Supplementary_Materials.docx and CONSORT_2025_WoodfieldBAM.docx downloaded and read. No patient-level data published.

verifiedSourceDetails.population: Rectal cancer anterior resection after1999;bowel continuity restored;age18–85;major LARS>30 and loose/frequent stools.
verifiedSourceDetails.design: Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled two-period crossover,5weeks per treatment,6week washout.1:1 sequence randomization.
verifiedSourceDetails.denominators: 289 screened,80 identified eligible,49 randomized,36 complete PP;18 completers in each sequence.19 SeHCAT-tested,16 with complete crossover data,17 with composite-response data.
verifiedSourceDetails.analysis: All analyses described as PP;approximately2% score imputation;participant/period mixed model reported. Completer analysis not recast as49-person ITT.
verifiedSourceDetails.composite: 12/36 versus3/36;unvalidated exploratory composite assembled from multiple outcomes. Not established primary efficacy or proven selection benefit.
verifiedSourceDetails.safety: 13 withdrawals:7 during colesevelam,6 during placebo;constipation caused3 and1 respectively. SupplementTableS5 counts symptoms,not severe-AE grade-specific outcomes.
verifiedSourceDetails.BAM: 8/19 tested positive;convenience geographic/funding subset,not prevalence estimate for allLARS. No confirmed subgroup efficacy.
